methodology.task: Frozen text-observation decision accuracy, not live task completion or screenshot performance.
methodology.ordering: Sequential requests; each observation is sent to every provider. Provider order rotates left one position each repetition.
methodology.latency: Provider adapter wall time includes network, OpenRouter routing, inference, response transfer and validation. All attempts included; no discarded warmup or local cache.
methodology.percentiles: Linear interpolation at sorted rank (n-1)*p; small N, descriptive only.
methodology.accuracy: All named choices must match ground truth; array ground truth accepts any listed choice. Request failures count as incorrect.
methodology.groundTruth: Only state and questions are passed to execute_decision. Expected answers are used after inference for scoring.
methodology.confidence: Native confidence and probabilities are preserved without calibration, thresholds, or transformations. Chat returns null confidence/probabilities.
methodology.clefRouting: cloudflare/clef-flash pinned to Cloudflare with provider.only and allow_fallbacks=false; no substituted models.
methodology.lunaRouting: openai/gpt-6-luna through OpenRouter Chat Completions, strict JSON schema, reasoning effort none.
limitations: Two observations per demo and three repetitions are not representative production coverage.
Repeated inputs may benefit from upstream prompt caches; no local result cache is used.
Frozen observations do not test model recovery from earlier mistakes or complete workflow success.

timing.measurement: server wall time; includes upstream network, routing, and inference
